title: InputTuning
description: The 'data' object of Data/Input/*.json. Mirrors FLRInputTuning (Source/LRInput/Public/LRInputTypes.h). Axis values are normalized [0, 1].

StickDeadZone.description: Inner dead zone of the analog sticks.

TriggerDeadZone.description: Inner dead zone of the analog triggers.

SteeringExponent.description: Exponent of the stick steering response curve (1 = linear).

LaneChangeThreshold.description: Arcade: |steer| that fires a lane change request.

LaneChangeReleaseThreshold.description: Arcade: |steer| under which the lane change detector re-arms. Must not exceed LaneChangeThreshold (clamped at runtime).

LaneChangeRepeatDelaySeconds.description: Arcade: seconds between repeated lane change requests while the stick is held. 0 disables repeat.

bInvertSteering.description: Inverts the analog stick steering axis.
